name: quality-review
title: Dataset quality review
for_each: select id,code from datasets order by code

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select rule,finding from v_compliance where dataset_id=$1

sections.title: Use-review evidence
sections.sql: select reviewer,purpose,evidence,created_at,expires_at from use_reviews where dataset_id=$1 order by created_at desc

name: corrective-action
title: Corrective action record
for_each: select id,code from actions order by code

name: check-register
title: Quality check register
for_each: select id,code from datasets order by code

sections.title: Rule definitions
sections.sql: select code,name,kind,field,lower_bound,upper_bound,allowed,max_failures,severity,enabled from rules where dataset_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Check history
sections.sql: select check_name,origin,measured_at,actual_value,failed_rows,severity from results where dataset_id=$1 order by measured_at desc
